solutions.explanation:
Write the product as one fraction so that its repeated factors are visible:

\[
\frac{1\cdot2\cdot3\cdots20}
{3\cdot4\cdot5\cdots22}.
\]

Every factor from \(3\) through \(20\) occurs once above and once below the fraction bar, so all of those factors cancel. What remains is

\[
\frac{1\cdot2}{21\cdot22}
=\frac{2}{462}
=\boxed{\frac1{231}}.
\]

The answer is choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\). In a product with shifted factors like this, look for the factors that survive at the two ends.
solutions.title: Cancel factors shared by the numerator and denominator
